source: USGS NLDAS-2 Noah watershed aggregation, DOI 10.5066/P9IKHEM3
selection: Per watershed and horizon, choose ridge only if calibration MAE is lower than persistence; otherwise persistence.
interval: Calibration 90th percentile absolute error; nominal 90% band, not a guaranteed probability.
daily_period_note: USGS metadata inconsistently says Central Standard Time and UTC-5. Original daily labels retained; exact local-date alignment not established.
evaluation_note: Retrospective later-release archive with simulated six-day availability delay. Not an as-issued vintage test. Overlapping horizons and watersheds are correlated.
